scope: One combined original-environment characterization source, tests, boundary and completed native evidence review. No host extraction or unchanged terrain/model review.

findings.title: Require actual typed family answers before counting a restored witness
findings.reason: Only a final marker with matching group/index and restored=1 is needed to increment measured coverage. No family answer, input/result field schema, fingerprint equality/width, duplicate key/event or exact census contract is enforced. A marker-only response is counted as measured, and the supplied positive stand-in actually emits env-wind for every group. A forged zero census can report complete with no cases. This weakens the characterization validator even though retained native reports contain the genuine C rows.
findings.correction: Validate the finite C-emitter protocol before success: supported bounded census/counts, exact family-specific row order/cardinality/types/word widths and input/index identity, explicit refusal forms, required before/result/after rows, and matching restored fingerprints. Reject duplicate/unknown/missing fields or rows. Add coherent positive collaborators plus genuine marker-only/wrong-family/missing-result/changed-fingerprint/census-corruption controls; no numerical expected-answer solver.

findings.title: Bound periodic catch-up independently of frame count
findings.reason: snapshot_every accepts .00000000001, but catch-up advances one period per while iteration. A single100ms frame then needs about10 billion iterations even though only one snapshot is emitted. MAX_FRAMES does not bound this loop or practical work.
findings.correction: Advance directly to the next due period with finite/progress checks or refuse schedules exceeding an explicit finite bound. Preserve intended periodic snapshot semantics and the unchanged default60s schedule. Exercise the real driver with a controlled clock for tiny positive periods/large jumps without running a huge loop or altering original environment math.

findings.title: Make the new real-driver guards portable to cross-built Windows binaries
findings.reason: The helper bakes CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR/lua and CARGO_BIN_EXE paths into the Windows test executable. In the documented Linux/Docker cross build those are /src and /target locations inaccessible to native Windows execution. Existing Linux passes do not establish Windows guard execution.
findings.correction: Embed the actual driver via include_str and copy it into a per-run temporary directory. Retain ordinary Cargo host selection for Linux and support a strict explicit runtime host override for Windows, refusing a supplied invalid path without fallback/skip. Validate actual native Windows guard execution separately. Do not rebuild or relabel the unchanged original C fixture just for this test wiring.

source_safety.original_C_execution: No new C memory/numerical/restoration blocker found for the finite already-measured cases; retained native measurements can be revalidated after driver/test-only fixes. This is not blanket approval for unsupported lightning/libc-reseed/save paths.
source_safety.feature_off: Appended original C wrappers and engine entry are entirely feature-guarded; new fixture is wholly guarded, Rust/API feature chain is consistent. Original C bytes independently checked as exact prefixes, including engine NUL1. No independent strict-preprocess run by reviewer is claimed.
source_safety.ABI: Only c_int group/index/capacity and caller-owned bounded text pointer cross private C/Rust FFI. Rust allocates32KiB, C checks engine state and pointer/capacity. No native pointers or session layout exported to Lua.
source_safety.bounds: Finite private tables hold55/21/33/22 entries within96/48/48/48 capacities; init7/time-update10/weather-update16 indices checked. Bounded snprintf checks every report segment. Returning output-error paths reach restore before refusal.
source_safety.restoration: Whole session copied/restored along with map season, shared random seed word and system_delta_time. Original called routines mutate only this saved state on selected cases. Camera is read, not modified; cockpit/no-camera/nonserver update and initialization preconditions are refused. Lightning timer is held high in controlled weather updates, preventing external strike/sound creation. Libc reseeding is never called.
source_safety.original_fidelity: Wrappers call the actual original static functions once at each requested operation; weather/wind query helpers call original functions and report input/output bit words without reimplementing result arithmetic. Time/range helpers used for diagnostics are read-only. Update order, RNG use and casts remain original. Return-state checks are rendered-state fingerprints, not an assertion that every global has been exhaustively observed.
source_safety.FPU: Calls inherit accepted6b engine entry/RZ behavior. No new full outer MXCSR preservation claim or borrowing of separately repaired model-source evidence. Generated boundary inputs and IEEE words are recorded under that actual context.
source_safety.clean_code: Finite family dispatch and state cleanup are localized. Required changes are validation/scheduler/test infrastructure, not physics, campaign policy, ABI redesign or oracle replacement.

actual_evidence.retained_report_validation: All concrete groups/indices checked against actual C-emitter row sequences, every expected answer/result present, every word/fingerprint syntax valid, every end restored=1 with fp_before==fp_after. No missing native answer detected. Driver weakness does not invalidate these independently inspected original rows.

moving_control_comparison.limits: Common snapshot rows and campaign endpoints exact; probe-only witness/before-after rows and explicit control coverage differ as expected. No full Tacview/all-engine-state or long-run lightning/sound/save behavior claim.

Linux_checks.default_and_feature_tests: Both affected-package test commands passed, including four new real-Lua stand-in driver guards; these protect flow only and do not validate physical environment answers.
Linux_checks.recovery_changes: Only /// to // on extern-block comment; declarations, C, Lua, tests and flags unchanged. No Windows/native rebuild or retest needed for this prose-only lint fix.
Linux_checks.Windows_driver_guards: NOT_EXECUTED; cross-built path finding remains open.

limits: Characterization only; no host authority, physical service cutover, formal GitHub approval, Task51 delivery, ordinary shipping acceptance or whole-D3 completion.

Retail probes cover current Georgia/Lebanon/seed1 and a120s Lebanon control, while synthetic seasons/cases are labelled synthetic. Shared rendered RNG/clock/camera restoration does not establish unsupported libc reseed, lightning entity/sound effects, resync transmission, client/save/unpack coverage.

Weather/wind/time host contract, D2 wind-lookup authority reversal, real physical consumers and required environment/terrain/model/entity/hierarchy/viewpoint/device/target-point/solver/loader removal remain D3; campaign scheduling/policy/consequences remain Core.

No original native rerun required solely for the three validator/scheduling/portable-test fixes if exact C/source/script transport correspondence and retained raw revalidation are recorded. New test/driver code still needs affected execution evidence.
No reviewer source edits/builds/tests/native/campaign/process/cache/Git/auth/external mutations or nested agents. Only this new private report written; Task47 and closed model code not re-reviewed.
